citations.analysis_notes: Trap A Falsification (Bound-Serial Founding-Year Metadata Poisoning): Primary scan inspected via view_file (CERT-2800-318.png). Pre-1910 date-bounded full-text queries on Internet Archive surface seemingly sensational '1883' baseball and '1898' outdoor-sporting hits for 'overcome the jinx' and 'trail of the jinx'. Inspection of Panel A printed title pages/covers immediately exposes serial-inception catalog misdating: Reach's American League Base Ball Guide carries serial founding year '1883' in IA metadata but is printed 'for 1920' (copyright 1919/1920) on leaf n10, and Rod and Gun in Canada carries founding year '1898' in IA metadata but is printed 'MARCH 1921' (Vol. 22, No. 10) on its front cover (leaf n2). Both postdate the 1911 baseline by 9-10 years.
